_about: Launch day data that is not part of a complex. The launch windows below are the OLD date-picking model, kept only so old saves and presets still load: 'cold' (legacyFront) becomes a cold front on day 0 at the chosen complex (the Challenger setup); 'mild' and 'warm' mean nothing now. The weather itself comes from each complex's climate in sections/pad/section.json (weather.js).
